g.text: column (i, j): h = k_f + 1 + Σ fill of the interface cells above k_f
force cells skb..skt (red dashed): the surface force f_s / M acts on each
(k_f = skb here: the top full cell)
hot dry solid: ghost height h_c - tan(fs_angle)
(liquid pushed out at the angle; 20° by default)
ghost at its own height = 90°, held back
